Biohazard - Deadly Silence.name: Resident Evil: Deadly Silence
Biohazard - Deadly Silence.summary: Resident Evil: Deadly Silence is an enhanced version of the original Resident Evil for the Nintendo DS. It was made to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the series. The key difference with the original game is the use of the dual screen and touch sensitive formats, among many gameplay additions. A primary map is displayed on the second screen, providing extra help in finding the important areas of the mansion. The lower touch screen can be used to open locks or, in a special 1st person perspective addition, fight off various versions of the evil dead. The game also includes wireless LAN support for up to four players with two different multiplayer game modes.

Bratz - Super Babyz.name: Bratz: Super Babyz
Bratz - Super Babyz.summary: Aliens have landed on Earth at the Stylesville Adventure Planet and one of their alien devices fell into the wrong hands and transformed the Babyz into Super Heroz! With their newfound Super Powers, the Babyz use their abilities to help the citizens of Stylesville and battle the evil invading aliens.

Color Cross.name: Color Cross
Color Cross.summary: Color Cross is a challenging puzzle game where the goal is to uncover the hidden picture by applying the right color to the appropriate square. Utilizing the familiar "paint by numbers" picture logic puzzle mechanic, completing a grid will reveal a portion of a larger hidden image as well as unlocking increasingly difficult challenges. With over 150 individual grids to unlock, Color Cross provides hours of brain-teasing gameplay that is colorful in more ways than one.

Katekyoo Hitman Reborn! DS - Flame Rumbl.name: Katekyou Hitman Reborn! DS: Flame Rumble - Mukuro Kyoshu

Metroid Prime - Hunters.name: Metroid Prime Hunters
Metroid Prime - Hunters.summary:
Metroid Prime Hunters is a first-person action-adventure game that combines exploration, shooting, and competitive multiplayer gameplay. Set across interconnected locations, it features objective-based progression alongside encounters with rival bounty hunters, each with distinct abilities and weapons.
The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, environmental navigation, and upgrade-driven progression, with both single-player and multiplayer modes supporting a variety of playstyles.

Petz - Horsez Family.name: Petz Horsez Family
Petz - Horsez Family.summary: Petz Horsez Family is the ultimate horse nurturing game. Care for a variety of horses at the Summer Camp Stables, bond with them, train them and even compete in fun challenges. Be a proud caretaker of your own horses as you learn how to take care of them and help them become strong and successful horses.

Turn It Around.name: Turn It Around
Turn It Around.summary: Turn It Around is a compilation game of 24 mini-games, each with their own set of goals. To complete them, the player must use the stylus on the touch screen to turn a wheel, each will test the players speed, power and technique for each.
